For each RTE API which is subject to variability and following the form component port or entity port in table 4.17 the RTE Configuration Header File shall contain one definition of a Condition Value #define Rte_VPCon__[_]_

_[_] where is the component type symbol of the AtomicSwComponentType , is the short name of the RunnableEntity , is the shortLabel of the RunnableEntity 's VariationPoint containing the reference element (e.g. a VariableAccess ) to the PortInterface element,

is the name of the PortPrototype , is the short name of the PortInterface element and is the shortLabel of the PortPrototype 's VariationPoint which is re- ferred by the VariableAccess If there is no VariationPoint at the RunnableEntity owning the VariableAc- cess the with leading underscore is omitted ( [_] ). If there is no VariationPoint at the PortPrototype referred by the Vari- ableAccess the with leading underscore is omitted ( [_] ). is the evaluated value of the ConditionByFormula of the Variation- Point vary the existence of the RTE API in table 4.17.
